Cold window daylight left, soft amber oil-lamp light, the same worn apartment. Frame from upper chest upward; the table and all gift objects stay BELOW frame. Begin with her hands below frame and eyes lowered toward the already-open comb case. She breathes through the last tears, lets her eyes rest on the gift, and quietly gathers herself. In the final two seconds she inclines forward slightly and reaches both hands below the lower frame to take her combs. End while her eyes are still down and her shoulders settle; the following separately edited shot will show the combs in her hands.
